templates.text: Tactile pathway myelination is markedly delayed, with proprioceptive and auditory pathways taking clear precedence.

Tactile pathway myelination is demonstrably sluggish, with visual and auditory tracts developing more rapidly.
There is a clear myelination deficit in the dorsal column-medial lemniscal pathway for fine touch.
Myelination of cortical tactile projection areas is significantly delayed relative to primary motor areas.
The spinothalamic tract for crude touch is myelinating well ahead of the discriminative tactile pathway.
